verdict: The corrected final suite has 54/54 correct saved answers. This is useful narrow synthetic evidence, not validation of general long-context reliability or the user's preferred 262K operating point. Fix the scorer, reproducibility, and generator ambiguities before further evaluation.

independent_checks.method: Compared complete saved answers against current suite metadata, removing only list numbering/bullets and outer whitespace, rather than trusting the substring scorer.
independent_checks.final_composite: 54/54: nine corrected mfr-v2 outputs plus 45 baseline outputs for other categories
independent_checks.baseline_original: 50/54, not the 51/54 stated in report.md's reproduction section
independent_checks.deployed_subset: 5/6 according to the saved expected answers; the remaining output uses a different rounding interpretation
independent_checks.interventions: Saved summary and structured runs each leave both initially failing dev items failing and change one previously passing dev item to failing. These were ambiguous v1 tasks.

findings.issue: The scorer is not exact. Abstention accepts any response containing 'not stated', including one that then invents a phone number. Numeric scoring falls back to substring matching, so expected 27 accepts 99927. Multi-fact scoring ignores extra trailing lines.
findings.impact: No observed false positives in the 54 saved final outputs, but future regression runs can silently pass incorrect answers.
findings.fix: Use complete normalized answer matching or an explicit task-specific parser that rejects contradictory/extra answers; add adversarial scorer checks.

findings.issue: Results are cached only by item ID and run name. Regenerating the corrected suite then following README's --run baseline command silently reuses all 54 old baseline records, including invalid v1 mfr results. Stored results have no prompt/content hash or suite revision to prevent stale reuse.
findings.fix: Use immutable versioned suite manifests and hash the exact prompt, expected answer, runtime and sampling configuration. Refuse incompatible cached results. Document a fresh run name without overwriting historical evidence.

findings.issue: Constraint persistence differs from its description: the rule is planted in section 7 after the fact in section 5 or 6. Whole-thousands wording and the 128450 -> 128K example do not distinguish rounding from truncation, although expected answers use round(). Random 'unrelated' project names also collide with the queried project in three current constraint items.
findings.fix: Place the rule before the later fact, specify the exact rounding convention, and exclude the queried project from unrelated distractors. Treat the deployed 178K/179K difference as an ambiguous-item result rather than a clean reliability comparison.

findings.issue: Interventions were tested only on ambiguous v1 prompts. The report's extension to interference on clean items is unsupported. Even formerly passing v1 cases can have ambiguous bindings.
findings.fix: Label these intervention results inconclusive for clean tasks; test corrected prompts and a fresh holdout before drawing effectiveness conclusions.

findings.issue: Broad capability and population failure-rate claims exceed suite coverage. Near-name cases give a direct-extension value to only the target; two-hop cases have only one planted target-range cost center. Repetitive filler and disjoint target namespaces allow simpler strategies than robust disambiguation/reasoning. Three items per group are not a representative independent sample of real workloads. The approximately 6.4% binomial upper bound is conditional on sampling assumptions, not a general failure-rate guarantee.
findings.fix: Report observed success on this suite. Add competing plausible values and independent document/task templates, reserve fresh holdouts, and evaluate near 262K occupied context with output headroom.

additional_reproduction_issues: verify_targets requires the transformed constraint answer to occur verbatim in the dossier. All nine constraint items therefore rebuild the identical seed 20 times and receive -r20 IDs, then are accepted without a successful validation check. Replace this with category-aware semantic generator assertions.
The --intervention marker option filters correction items but does not transform their prompts; it currently cannot test a marker intervention.
gen_mfr samples nominal depths but never uses depth to place facts. Measure actual token positions rather than interpreting those sampled depths as achieved coverage.
scope_limits: Only synthetic suite artifacts and source were examined. No private conversations read.
No GPU workloads or server requests issued; no production configuration changed and no artifacts deleted.
Replica image/flag equivalence, historical cleanup and present GPU occupancy were not independently verified from a retained runtime manifest.
Original scripts and results remain unchanged; this review does not rerun the eight-hour experiment.
